status.description: ACTIVE holds the lane. RELEASING means external teardown is in flight, so a lease left here was interrupted and must be reconciled rather than assumed free. ORPHANED_EXTERNAL_LOCK means an LFS lock or worktree survived the release: the lane stays quarantined until `exec reconcile` frees it, because a teardown Forge only attempted is not a teardown that happened.

owner_pid.description: Process that took the lease, checked for liveness before the clock is allowed to free the lane.

owner_machine.description: Machine the owner runs on. Liveness is only checkable from that machine.

owner_process_start.description: Owner's process start time, so a reused pid does not read as the original owner still working.

heartbeat_at.description: Last renewal. Work outrunning the TTL renews rather than losing its lane.

recoverable_after.description: Earliest a lease taken on another machine may be recovered, since liveness cannot be proven from here.

unreleased.description: External resources a release or reconcile could not free. Non-empty means the write scope is quarantined.
